findings.where: Motion sketch section, the full-width lavender panel (desktop-05; phone-03 to phone-04)
findings.fault: The motion section sits on a large lavender field, a hue that is in neither the house colours nor the tile's own palette. The palette names four colours: paper, grey, blue and pad yellow. The lavender is the loudest ground on the sheet, and the blue 'Replay the entrance' link and the blue curve sit on it. It reads as a fifth colour with no job, or as a leftover from another tile.
findings.who_objects: The founder, who asked for every tile to be built in or around #0070C0 and #404040, with one soft ground, the blue and grey as the only ink and at most one accent. A lavender block makes Counsel's paper look less restrained than it claims, and a purple cast is exactly what the brief has the photographs graded away from.

findings.where: Pad yellow: the palette swatch says it is for 'the address strip', but the only place it shows is the small bar in the Texture swatch (desktop-02/03, phone-02); there is no address strip on the first screen or anywhere else
findings.fault: The direction's one colour memory, the legal-pad yellow behind the contact panel or one quotation, is never put on a real surface. The palette gives it a job, and no part of the page does that job. So the sheet never shows how the yellow looks next to the paper, the grey ink and the blue address.
findings.who_objects: The founder, who is judging whether the legal pad can be saved 'with careful intention' and needs to see the exact shade and how much of it there is in use. A swatch and a 140 px sliver in a texture box cannot answer whether the yellow reads as refined or as a canary pad.

findings.where: Palette section, the four swatches (desktop-02, phone-01)
findings.fault: The four colour chips are drawn as four different shapes: a square-cornered rectangle with a grey hairline, a rounded rectangle with no edge, an ellipse with a dark outline, and a square rectangle with a thick blue border. Like parts are treated unlike. The blue border on the yellow chip also suggests the two are used together, though the notes keep blue on yellow to large type only.
findings.who_objects: The founder and any later builder reading the sheet as a spec. The mixed corners and edges look like a mistake, and they leave unclear which corner and border this direction uses. The tile's own text says square at every corner.

findings.where: Article specimen, the lectern photograph (desktop-03 to desktop-04, phone-02 to phone-03)
findings.fault: The grey grading turns the stage backdrop into a solid dark charcoal block, close to the logo grey and the full width of the text column. It is by far the heaviest area on the page and sits on the pale paper with no edge or step between. The article page loses the quiet, low-contrast paper the direction is built on.
findings.who_objects: Mark's readers, the development-bank staff reading the article, see a slab of near-black that pulls the eye off the text. The founder asked for one soft ground at low contrast. Angélique would get the same dark slab on every article photo that has a coloured backdrop.
